title: A scan that errors partway reports 0 failed films and overwrites the last count
notes: ScanCounting returns failed before it is computed on early errors (List, loadSeen, dropSeen); scanLoop sets jellyscale_scan_last_failed_films unconditionally. Success is still 0, so only the count misleads. Leave the gauge as it was when the scan errored, or compute the count before every return.
